tool_args.rationale: The pilot varies u_now and s_grad together and provides only five observations. The open-branch probe is the least costly available targeted measurement for resolving the resulting structural ambiguity.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the recalled stationary model families now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations confound substrate and gradient effects, leaving the mechanism insufficiently identified.
The immediate ambiguity concerns the response branches rather than fine temporal dynamics; this probe costs more.
It is not relevant to discriminating the candidate mechanisms.
